view.sqlSentence: SELECT CAST(CONCAT(YEAR(invoice.issue_date), "/", LPAD(MONTH(invoice.issue_date),2,"0")) AS CHAR), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM pcategory, invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, invoice_tax WHERE invoice_detail.item = item.id AND item.product = product.id AND product.category = pcategory.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND pcategory.id = ? AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?,"-",?,"-",1), "%Y-%m-%d"), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?,"-",? + 1,"-",1), "%Y-%m-%d"), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND invoice.type = ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
